confidence_rationale: The canonical formal treatment decomposing the value of a policy into pragmatic (reward/harm) and epistemic (uncertainty-reducing) components, so that information-gathering actions are selected even when not immediately rewarding. Directly grounds MECH-388 (epistemic action pressure as a survival-relevant viability function) and the active-inference half of L5. Confidence capped by the formalism's strong assumptions (expected-free-energy minimisation) which REE does not adopt wholesale, and by it being theory rather than a single decisive empirical test.
failure_signatures: Anti-epistemic panic: an agent weighting only pragmatic value commits under threat without sampling -- the active-inference account predicts this as failure to value epistemic gain.

Epistemic freezing: the dual failure -- over-weighting epistemic value so the agent keeps gathering information and never commits -- is the over-exploration tail the pragmatic/epistemic balance must bound.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Under active inference, agents minimise the expected free energy of future outcomes; the quality of a policy decomposes into extrinsic/pragmatic value (preferred outcomes) and epistemic/intrinsic value (expected information gain / uncertainty reduction), so optimal behaviour includes actions chosen purely to resolve uncertainty about hidden states.
mapping.ree_translation: Formal backbone of MECH-388: when goal success or harm avoidance depends on hidden state, REE should assign action pressure to uncertainty-reducing transitions even when not immediately reward/harm-optimal -- 'the intelligent action may be one that TESTS where safety is.' Also reframes Q-044 curiosity machinery as a survival-relevant viability function, not only play/exploration.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Active inference packages pragmatic and epistemic value into one expected-free-energy scalar; REE keeps harm, goal, and epistemic pressure as separate streams and has not committed to free-energy minimisation. The shared, transferable point is the EXISTENCE and selectability of epistemic value; the unifying scalar formalism is explicitly NOT adopted (and Q-044's sub-flavour-independence question must be adjudicated before generalising curiosity).
mapping.source_context: Theoretical / computational neuroscience review with simulation illustrations; not a clinical or single-cell empirical study.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality good (canonical, heavily cited) but theory-with-simulation rather than decisive experiment. Mapping fidelity good for epistemic-value existence; transfer risk moderate due to free-energy formalism REE does not adopt.
